title: 第13章 逗猴第14章 白狐
content_zh:
张皓旸修为连续突破尚未稳固，真气虚浮，无法真正吸收炼化的部分真气依旧在体内乱窜。
此时有数只壮硕的赤面猴正向他走来，带头的那只壮硕的赤面猴可是三阶妖兽，三阶妖兽可是相当于人类筑基境的修为，单就它一只，张皓旸就无法应对，况且它身后还跟着数只二阶、一阶的赤面猴。
看它们的表情就知道，它们逼近张皓旸后肯定会与他发生激烈的冲突。
这一突然状况使本就刚突破，心神有些紊乱的张皓旸更加焦躁，之前又有那一罐猴儿酒下肚，满心焦躁加上酒劲又已上头的缘故。
当张皓旸在看到几只壮硕的赤面猴向他逼近时竟是突然紧张无比起来。
在这种异常复杂的情况之下，刚突破修为的张皓旸，急火攻心竟是眼前一黑，直接一头栽倒在山洞内。
不知过了多久，张皓旸缓缓睁开双眼，他感觉自己双手被捆绑在一根石柱上，他尝试用力挣扎却无法挣脱开，他侧头查看，自己的双手被一根绿色的藤蔓困住，藤蔓绑的非常紧，他根本无法挣脱。
张皓旸抬头看向四周，只见在他对面有一只壮硕的赤面猴正瞪大眼睛看着他，这只赤面猴是二阶妖兽，与人类炼体境修士相当，它坐在许多盛有猴儿酒的泥罐旁边瞪大眼睛看守着张皓旸，至于其他的赤面猴则不知去了哪里？
张皓旸既然无法挣脱就要另想办法才行，他可不能被这群赤面猴绑在这里，赤面猴虽然不是凶残的妖兽，但它们毕竟也是妖兽，妖兽喜怒无常，一旦兽性大发，在那只三阶的赤面猴面前，张皓旸只有等死别无他法！
张皓旸的大脑在飞速运转，他在思考如何脱困？一段有关赤面猴的描述出现在脑海之中。
赤面猴喜热闹，善学好动、活泼好奇！
既然有此特性，那就针对它好奇、好动的特性试试运气！
下一刻，就见张皓旸坐在石柱前不停的扭动身体，然后运用真气将身边已打开的泥罐中的猴儿酒缓缓吸入口中。
看到张皓旸的这个怪异举动，赤面猴好奇不已！
在强大好奇心的驱使下，那只赤面猴竟也依葫芦画瓢有样学样起来，只见它也不断扭动身体。
由于这只赤面猴只是二阶妖兽，它对真气尚无法操控，也就无法通过真气将泥罐中的猴儿酒吸入口中，见无法如张皓旸那般将猴儿酒吸入口中，这只赤面猴就干脆直接抱起身旁的一个泥罐，撕掉上面用红泥密封的树叶，将猴儿酒直接倒入口中，它“咕咚”
“咕咚”
喝了几大口，随后它就对着张皓旸“吱吱”
叫了几声，好似在对张皓旸说：“我不用向你那样也能喝到猴儿酒！”
脸上满是炫耀之色。

赤面猴善于酿酒却不善于饮酒，张皓旸一直在用真气喝酒，当然他是控制了吸入猴儿酒的总量，他可不想与之前那样喝多了直接醉倒？
张皓旸一直在喝，那只赤面猴也抱着泥罐一直在喝。
当喝了一罐猴儿酒后，那只赤面猴明显亢奋起来。
张皓旸依旧运用真气隔空将猴儿酒吸入空中，当赤面猴已经喝光一罐时，他也就喝了不到四分之一。
喝完一罐的赤面猴看到张皓旸依旧在喝，于是就又打开一罐，又抱起喝了起来。
content_en:
Zhang Haoyang's continuous breakthroughs in cultivation have not been stable yet, and his true energy is weak. The part of his true energy that cannot be truly absorbed and refined is still flowing around in his body.
At this time, several sturdy red-faced monkeys were walking towards him. The leading red-faced monkey was a third-order monster. The third-order monster was equivalent to the cultivation level of a human being at the Foundation Establishment Realm. Zhang Haoyang couldn't deal with it alone. Moreover, there were several second-order and first-order red-faced monkeys behind it.
You can tell from their expressions that they will definitely have a fierce conflict with Zhang Haoyang after they approach him.
This sudden situation made Zhang Haoyang, who had just made a breakthrough and was a little confused, even more anxious. He had drunk the can of monkey wine before, and he was full of anxiety and was drunk.
When Zhang Haoyang saw several sturdy red-faced monkeys approaching him, he suddenly became extremely nervous.
Under this extremely complicated situation, Zhang Haoyang, who had just broken through in cultivation, was so anxious that his vision went dark and he fell headlong into the cave.
After an unknown amount of time, Zhang Haoyang slowly opened his eyes. He felt that his hands were tied to a stone pillar. He tried to struggle but could not break free. He looked sideways and saw that his hands were trapped by a green vine. The vine was tied very tightly and he could not break free at all.
Zhang Haoyang looked up and looked around, only to see a sturdy red-faced monkey opposite him looking at him with wide eyes. This red-faced monkey was a second-level monster, comparable to a human body-refining monk. It sat next to many clay jars filled with monkey wine and watched Zhang Haoyang with wide-eyed eyes. As for the other red-faced monkeys, I don't know where they went?
Since Zhang Haoyang couldn't break free, he had to find another way. He couldn't be tied up here by this group of red-faced monkeys. Although the red-faced monkeys were not ferocious monsters, they were still monsters after all. Monsters were moody. Once their bestial nature was unleashed, Zhang Haoyang had no choice but to wait for death in front of the third-level red-faced monkey!
Zhang Haoyang's brain is running rapidly. He is thinking about how to get out of trouble? A description of a red-faced monkey comes to mind.
Red-faced monkeys like to be active, eager to learn, active, and lively and curious!
Since it has this characteristic, try your luck on its curious and active characteristics!
The next moment, Zhang Haoyang was seen sitting in front of the stone pillar, twisting his body constantly, and then used his true energy to slowly inhale the monkey wine in the open clay jar next to him.
Seeing Zhang Haoyang's strange behavior, the red-faced monkey was very curious!
Driven by strong curiosity, the red-faced monkey actually followed suit, and it was seen that it kept twisting its body.
Since this red-faced monkey is only a second-level monster, it cannot control the true energy, so it cannot inhale the monkey wine in the clay jar through the true energy. Seeing that it cannot inhale the monkey wine into the mouth like Zhang Haoyang did, the red-faced monkey simply picked up a clay jar next to it, tore off the leaves sealed with red mud on it, and poured the monkey wine directly into the mouth. It "gudong"
"Gudong"
After taking a few sips, it "squeaked" at Zhang Haoyang
He shouted a few times, as if saying to Zhang Haoyang: "I don't have to do that to you to drink monkey wine!"
His face was full of show off.
The red-faced monkey is good at making wine but not good at drinking. Zhang Haoyang has been drinking with his true energy. Of course, he has controlled the total amount of monkey wine he inhales. Doesn't he want to get drunk immediately after drinking too much like before?
Zhang Haoyang kept drinking, and the red-faced monkey also kept drinking from the clay pot.
After drinking a can of monkey wine, the red-faced monkey became obviously excited.
Zhang Haoyang still used his true energy to inhale the monkey wine into the air. When the red-faced monkey had finished the whole bottle, he had only drank less than a quarter.
After finishing one can, the red-faced monkey saw that Zhang Haoyang was still drinking, so he opened another can, picked it up and drank again.
